column1: # The entries of the 1876 State Department Red Cipher (John H. Haswell), column 'Message or true reading', that the contributor used for this telegram (issue #353). The first three digits of a group give the printed page, the last two the entry. The codebook is NARA, RG 59, T1171 roll 1, 'Codebooks of the Department of State, 1867-1876', catalog id 417267710, one printed page per image: https://catalog.archives.gov/medialz/dc-metro/rg-059/2034503/T1171/T1171-01/T1171-01-NNNN.jpg (public, fetched with curl). Columns page, image and checked added 14 Nov 2026: every entry below was looked up on its page image by the project (Claude) and agrees with the contributor's entry; the page number was read on each image header.

# Spelling: the first group 56169 is the spelling key; rows 5 6 1 6 of the first division of the spelling table, coded letters U A W C read at the tops of their columns give K I E L. Checked 14 Nov 2026 on the spelling code, division 1, page 579 (image 0577): row 5 has U under K, row 6 A under I, row 1 W under E, row 6 C under L.
